# How to Build.

```
1. Confirm the real, current L1StandardBridge address for Base Sepolia
   from Base's own docs (see this Assignment's own intro).

2. Confirm the deployerKey wallet's own balance on BOTH chains before
   starting, so the deposit's own effect is measurable:

     <!-- Make sure you set the sepolia & base_sepolia rpc url as environment varible. -->
     <!-- export sepolia="https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com" -->
     <!-- export base_sepolia="https://sepolia.base.org" -->

     cast balance $(cast wallet address --account deployerKey) --rpc-url sepolia
     cast balance $(cast wallet address --account deployerKey) --rpc-url base_sepolia

3. Call depositETH directly, sending 0.01 real Sepolia ETH:

     cast send <L1_STANDARD_BRIDGE_ADDRESS> "depositETH(uint32,bytes)" 200000 "0x" \
       --value 0.01ether --rpc-url sepolia --account deployerKey
```
